> Can you give me an example of "ability-sourced Base DMG?"
These are the ones I've tested and confirmed:
Kath's "Endless Purgatory" talent (+5% base dmg per Combust gained this combat).
24 Exalt (+20% dmg per Exalt used this battle).
I assume Clementine's E2 talent works the same, but I can't test it.

> but for example, Cetus Occasus increases Crit. DMG of Strikes, not Base DMG. It's not possible for it to be additive with Celestial Beast.
Apologies, I'm not sure why that one was in there, I removed it. 
I just filled in a bunch of abilities based on their wording, and then tested to confirm some of them afterwards. There's a "tested" column there for the ones I've confirmed to be in the correct category. Some of the wheels I don't even own so can't confirm, I put them where they are based on the wording.
> If I'm reading your sheet correctly, you're saying that Weeping Pipe and Black Candle are mutually additive?
Yes, like every Relic that modifies base damage%, they all add to the same additive stack. 
> From what I understand, column B and column C are mutually additive of each other, 
Every column represents one additive stack. 
> and everything in columns D and E are individually multiplicative.
They're not. You can easily test this ingame by using 2 different sources of this, like Steppenwolf + Will Unyielding. 
Same for base dmg from Relics, it's one additive stack, though you need 2 of them to test it so could take a bit longer (don't think there's a stage that allows you to start with base dmg relic right now).

If you don't understand the way I explain this it should be easy enough to just read the formulas in the spreadsheet to see how this works.

I'm not a very good teacher so not sure how to represent this in a more understandable way.
This is how it works:
Final ATK = Base ATK stat * ATK multipliers, then round up this product.
Initial base dmg = Final ATK * ATKscaling% * (Ability-source base dmg%+1), then round up this product.
Then we calculate each individual base dmg multiplier:
- Sum every equipped item in "Specific card / exalt base dmg%"+1.
- Sum every equipped item in "Card base dmg%"+1
- Sum every equipped item in "General base dmg%"+1
- Sum every active Relic in "Relic base dmg%"+1
- Sum active ability in "Other base dmg%"+1 (only example I have is 24's Soulforge talent +20-50% base dmg)
- Sum dmg amp bonuses, then round up +1 (if you start exploration and plug in the value from your keeper tooltip you don't have to do any rounding)

All of these 6 are then multiplied with each other and with initial base dmg. 

Then add everything from STR and similar dmg add on top of this (shortening the explanation of how to calculate this step since I think you understand it perfectly already). 
IDK what to call this, it's just "base dmg with dmg add" in my spreadsheet.

Calculate final damage bonuses: 
- Sum every relevant bonus in "Party dmg%"+1 (for example Vision Corrector + Horla Anger)
- Sum every relevant bonus in the "Final dmg%"+1 (for example Fiamma + SULtra)
- Sum other dmg%+1 (dunno what to call this category since the only item in it so far is Pollux wheel active "Ablaze" and "Alight" buff).
- 1-Weakness value (normally 25% if applicable).

Then multiply these with each other and with [base dmg with dmg add]
The result of this is the display dmg on the card/exalt.

Honestly, the only final damage bonuses I found so far that are additive are Horla+Vision Corrector, and Fiamma+SUltra. I'm sure there are more though, because I haven't tested many.

In any case, the reason I even posted this in an unfinished state is I'm getting bored with the game and probably not going to add much from this point on, so it was either this or nothing. If someone wants to do a more thorough job on figuring out how things work this will allow you to skip a lot of busywork.
